==Description==
The '''Lunar Servant''' was a boss that appeared in the fourth night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It had a high amount of health and a very slow speed. It had one ability, where it spawned multiple enemies, these being the [[Lunar Shard]], [[Solar Shard]], [[Cursed Knight]], [[Cursed Guard]] and [[Flare]].

==Appearance==
The '''Lunar Servant''' had grey skin. Its legs and torso were dark purple. It wore a dark purple robe, pink gloves and grey shoulder-pads. It had a large white crystal on its torso. It had a neon white halo floating above its head and a moon shaped object behind it. It also had a dark grey hat with neon purple and white wings. It wielded a moon staff.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]] and [[Ranger]] are recommended to defeat this enemy.
**The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can help boost these towers.
*Because of its freeze and poison immunities, the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Sledger]] cannot slow this enemy down.
**As it has [[Energy Immunity]], the [[Electroshocker]] can only slow it down instead of stunning it. Additionally, due to its large size, it can also only slow this down for a short amount of time.
*Be aware that the enemies that spawn before the '''Lunar Servant''' have relatively high health, allowing it to walk further before getting damaged.
**Additionally, the '''Lunar Servant''' will spawn one more time on wave 16 with the [[Solar Servant]] and [[The Umbra]], making it even more dangerous.
